notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 timestamped directed-interaction and retraction surface. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies targeted and universal timestamped directed-interaction delivery, target and handle boundaries, constrained time servicing, Request Retraction callbacks, and lifecycle cleanup without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador timestamped directed-interaction and retraction services with FederateAmbassador timestamped directed receive and retraction callbacks
